  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 10, 2020

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the February 03, 2020, meeting.

  2. Hillcrest Medical Clinic – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the
  services for pre-employment, physical exams and random alcohol testing.

  3. Natural Gas Systems, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  services in repairing the City Natural Gas pumps.

  4. Ford Motor Credit Company LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  the lease of 15 vehicles for the City’s Police fleet.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

City of Inglewood
  Finance Department

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 10, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference on
the 9th floor at 11:40 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Debbie Crenshaw, City Treasurer
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes- Human Resources
  Cliff Pate – Fleet Services

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of February 03, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Hillcrest Medical Clinic - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  services for pre-employment, physical exams and random alcohol testing in the
  amount of $2,372.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Natural Gas Systems, Inc. - Item pulled.

  4. Ford Motor Credit Company LLC – Executive session to discuss recommended
  payment for the lease of 15 vehicles for the City’s Police fleet in the amount of
  $3,719.88. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:51 a.m. Adjournment
